hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty'); [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; root=$(git -C "$(dirname "$f")" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; [ -x "$root/node_modules/.bin/biome" ] || root="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"; out=$(cd "$root" && ./node_modules/.bin/biome check --write --no-errors-on-unmatched --files-ignore-unknown=true "$f" 2>&1) || { echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; }
